text:
**Sometimes—but not always.** Bundles can be cheaper when the maker discounts the kit: for example, a [BLUETTI AC180 with a 100W panel](https://powersized.com/solar-generator-kits/) was listed at $649 versus $748 for the parts separately, a $99 saving. An [EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic with a 160W panel](https://powersized.com/solar-generator-kits/) was listed at $669 versus $848 separately, saving $179.

But separate purchases can win if the power station or a compatible third-party panel is on sale. One comparison found an AC180 plus a third-party 200W panel could cost about $659, less than the $729 bundle ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-kit-vs-buying-separately)).

So compare the **actual kit price** with the station and panel prices at checkout, and check that any separate panel’s voltage and connector work with the power station.

products: EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic + 160W Solar Panel Kit
judge.why: The lead examples (AC180 + 100W and DELTA 3 Classic + 160W kits) and their prices come from powersized.com, and the 100W AC180 kit isn't our listed 200W kit, while dealectric.com is cited only for the one third-party-panel comparison.
